ps2.1:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Ānando Kosambiyaṃ viharati Ghosītārāme.
ps2.1:1.3: Tatra kho āyasmā Ānando bhikkhū āmantesi.
ps2.1:1.5: ‘Āvuso' ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Ānandassa paccassosuṃ.
ps2.1:2.1: ‘Yo hi koci āvuso bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā mama santike Arahattapattiṃ byākaroti, sabbaso catūhi maggehi etesaṃ vā aññatarena.
ps2.1:3.1: Idh' āvuso bhikkhu samathapubbaṅgamaṃ vipassanaṃ bhāveti,
ps2.1:3.2: tassa samathapubbaṅgamaṃ vipassanaṃ bhāvayato maggo sañjāyati.
ps2.1:3.3: So taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti,
ps2.1:3.4: tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saññojanāni pahīyanti, anusayā byantihonti.
ps2.1:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhu vipassanāpubbaṅgamaṃ samathaṃ bhāveti,
ps2.1:4.2: tassa vipassanāpubbaṅgamaṃ samathaṃ bhāvayato maggo sañjāyati.
ps2.1:4.3: So taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti;
ps2.1:4.4: tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saññojanāni pahīyanti, anusayā byantihonti.
ps2.1:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhu samathavipassanaṃ yuganandhaṃ bhāveti,
ps2.1:5.2: tassa samathavipassanaṃ yuganandhaṃ bhāvayato maggo sañjāyati.
ps2.1:5.3: So taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti;
ps2.1:5.4: tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saññojanāni pahīyanti, anusayā byantihonti.
ps2.1:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso bhikkhuno dhammuddhaccaviggahitaṃ mānasaṃ hoti.
ps2.1:6.2: So āvuso samayo, yan taṃ cittaṃ ajjhattañ ñeva santiṭṭhati sannisīdati, ekodi hoti samādhiyati;
ps2.1:6.4: So taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti,
ps2.1:6.5: tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saññojanāni pahīyanti, anusayā byantihonti.
ps2.1:7.1: Yo hi koci āvuso bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā mama santike Arahattapattiṃ byākaroti, sabbaso imehi catūhi maggehi etesaṃ vā aññatarenāti. Paṭis_II,I.2:
ps2.1:8.3: tattha jāte dhamme aniccato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, dukkhato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, anattato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā.
ps2.1:8.8: tattha jātānaṃ dhammānaṃ anativattanaṭṭhena bhāvanā, indriyānaṃ ekarasaṭṭhena bhāvanā, tadupagaviriyavāhanaṭṭhena bhāvanā, āsevanaṭṭhena bhāvanā.
ps2.1:9.2: Dassanaṭṭhena sammādiṭṭhi maggo sañjāyati, abhiropanaṭṭhena sammāsaṅkappo maggo sañjayāti, pariggahaṭṭhena sammāvācā maggo sañjāyati, samuṭṭhānaṭṭhena sammākammanto maggo sañjāyati, vodānaṭṭhena sammā-ājīvo maggo sañjāyati, paggahaṭṭhena sammāvāyāmo maggo sañjāyati, upaṭṭhanaṭṭhena sammāsati maggo sañjāyati, avikkhepaṭṭhena sammāsamādhi maggo sañjāyati.
ps2.1:10.1: ‘So taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkarotīti'. ‘Āsevatīti'. Kathaṃ āsevati?
ps2.1:10.2: Āvajjanto āsevati, jānanto āsevati, passanto āsevati, paccavekkhanto āsevati, cittaṃ adhiṭṭhahanto āsevati; saddhāya adhimuccanto āsevati, viriyaṃ paggaṇhanto āsevati, satiṃ upaṭṭhapento āsevati, cittaṃ samādahanto āsevati, paññāya pajānanto āsevati; abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānanto āsevati, pariññeyyaṃ parijānanto āsevati, pahātabbaṃ pajahanto āsevati, bhāvetabbaṃ bhāvento āsevati, sacchikātabbaṃ sacchikaronto āsevati.
ps2.1:11.2: Āvajjanto bhāveti, jānanto bhāveti, passanto bhāveti, paccavekkhanto bhāveti, cittaṃ adhiṭṭhahanto bhāveti; saddhāya adhimuccanto bhāveti, viriyaṃ paggaṇhanto bhāveti, satiṃ upaṭṭhapento bhāveti, cittaṃ samādahanto bhāveti, paññāya pajānanto bhāveti; abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānanto bhāveti, pariññeyyaṃ parijānanto bhāveti, pahātabbaṃ pajahanto bhāveti, bhāvetabbaṃ bhāvento bhāveti, sacchikātabbaṃ sacchikaronto bhāveti.
ps2.1:12.2: Āvajjanto bahulīkaroti, jānanto bahulīkaroti, passanto bahulīkaroti, paccavekkhanto bahulīkaroti, cittaṃ adhiṭṭhahanto bahulīkaroti; saddhāya adhimuccanto bahulīkaroti, viriyaṃ paggaṇhanto bahulīkaroti, satiṃ upaṭṭhapento bahulīkaroti, cittaṃ samādahanto bahulīkaroti, paññāya pajānanto bahulīkaroti; abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānanto bahulīkaroti, pariññeyyaṃ parijānanto bahulīkaroti, pahātabbaṃ pajahanto bahulīkaroti, bhāvetabbaṃ bhāvento bahulīkaroti, sacchikātabbaṃ sacchikaronto bahulīkaroti.
ps2.1:13.1: ‘Tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saññojanāni pahīyanti, anusayā byantihontīti'. Kathaṃ saññojanāni pahīyanti, anusayā byantihonti?
ps2.1:13.14: Arahattamaggena rūparāgo arūparāgo māno uddhaccaṃ avijjā --
ps2.1:13.18: Evaṃ saññojanāni pahīyanti, anusayā byantihonti. Paṭis_II,I.3:
ps2.1:14.2: ālokasaññāvasena cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi . . . pe . . .
ps2.1:14.3: paṭinissaggānupassī assāsavasena, paṭinissaggānupassī passāsavasena cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi,
ps2.1:14.4: tattha jāte dhamme aniccato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, dukkhato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, anattato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā.
ps2.1:14.9: tattha jātānaṃ dhammānaṃ anativattanaṭṭhena bhāvanā, indriyānaṃ ekarasaṭṭhena bhāvanā, tadupagaviriyavāhanaṭṭhena bhāvanā, āsevanaṭṭhena bhāvanā.
ps2.1:15.2: Dassanaṭṭhena sammādiṭṭhi maggo sañjāyati, abhiropanaṭṭhena sammāsaṅkappo maggo sañjāyati . . . pe . . .

ps2.1:17.14: Arahattamaggena rūparāgo arūparāgo māno uddhaccaṃ avijjā --
ps2.1:18.2: Aniccato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, dukkhato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, anattato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā;
ps2.1:18.3: tattha jātānaṃ dhammānañ ca vossaggārammaṇatā cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo
ps2.1:18.4: samādhi. Iti paṭhamaṃ vipassanā pacchā samatho;
ps2.1:19.1: Rūpaṃ aniccato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, rūpaṃ dukkhato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, rūpaṃ anattato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā;
ps2.1:19.2: tattha jātānaṃ dhammānañ ca vossaggārammaṇatā cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi.
ps2.1:20.6: jarāmaraṇaṃ aniccato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā, jarāmaraṇaṃ dukkhato . . . pe . . .
ps2.1:20.8: tattha jātānaṃ dhammānañ ca vossaggārammaṇatā cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi.
ps2.1:21.3: ārammaṇaṭṭhena gocaraṭṭhena pahānaṭṭhena pariccāgaṭṭhena vuṭṭhānaṭṭhena vivaṭṭanaṭṭhena santaṭṭhena paṇītaṭṭhena vimuttaṭṭhena anāsavaṭṭhena taraṇaṭṭhena animittaṭṭhena appaṇihitaṭṭhena suññataṭṭhena ekarasaṭṭhena anativattanaṭṭhena yuganandhaṭṭhena.
ps2.1:22.2: Uddhaccaṃ pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi nirodhārammaṇo, avijjaṃ pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā nirodhārammaṇā.
ps2.1:22.3: Iti ārammaṇaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganandhā honti, aññamaññaṃ nātivattantīti;
ps2.1:23.2: Uddhaccaṃ pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi nirodhagocaro, avijjaṃ pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā nirodhagocarā.
ps2.1:23.3: Iti gocaraṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganandhā honti, aññamaññaṃ nātivattantīti;
ps2.1:24.2: Uddhaccasahagatakilese ca khandhe ca pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi nirodhagocaro, avijjāsahagatakilese ca khandhe ca pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā nirodhagocarā.
ps2.1:24.3: Iti pahānaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganandhā honti, aññamaññaṃ nātivattantīti;
ps2.1:25.2: Uddhaccasahagatakilese ca khandhe ca pariccajato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi nirodhagocaro, avijjāsahagatakilese ca khandhe ca pariccajato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā nirodhagocarā.
ps2.1:25.3: Iti pariccāgaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganandhā honti, aññamaññaṃ nātivattantīti;
ps2.1:26.2: Uddhaccasahagatakilesehi ca khandhehi ca vuṭṭhahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi nirodhagocaro, avijjāsahagatakilesehi ca khandhehi ca vuṭṭhahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā nirodhagocarā.
ps2.1:26.3: Iti vuṭṭhānaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganandhā honti, aññamaññaṃ nātivattantīti;
ps2.1:27.2: Uddhaccasahagatakilesehi ca khandhehi ca vivaṭṭato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi nirodhagocaro, avijjāsahagatakilesehi ca khandhehi ca vivaṭṭato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā nirodhagocarā.
ps2.1:27.3: Iti vivaṭṭanaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganandhā honti, aññamaññaṃ nātivattantīti;
ps2.1:28.2: Uddhaccaṃ pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi santo hoti nirodhagocaro, avijjaṃ pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā santā hoti nirodhagocarā.
ps2.1:28.3: Iti santaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganandhā honti, aññamaññaṃ nātivattantīti;
ps2.1:29.2: Uddhaccaṃ pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi paṇīto hoti nirodhagocaro, avijjaṃ pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā paṇītā hoti nirodhagocarā.
ps2.1:29.3: Iti paṇītaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganandhā honti, aññamaññaṃ nātivattantīti;
ps2.1:30.2: Uddhaccaṃ pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi vimutto hoti nirodhagacaro, avijjaṃ pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā vimuttā hoti nirodhagocarā;
ps2.1:30.3: iti rāgavirāgā cetovimutti, avijjāvirāgā paññāvimutti. Iti vimuttaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganandhā honti, aññamaññaṃ nātivattantīti;
ps2.1:31.2: Uddhaccaṃ pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi kāmāsavena anāsavo hoti nirodhagocaro, avijjaṃ pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā avijjāsavena anāsavā hoti nirodhagocarā.
ps2.1:31.3: Iti anāsavaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganandhā honti, aññamaññaṃ nātivattantīti;
ps2.1:32.2: Uddhaccasahagatakilesehi ca khandhehi ca tarato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi nirodhagocaro, avijjāsahagatakilesehi ca khandhehi ca tarato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā nirodhagocarā.
ps2.1:32.3: Iti taraṇaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganandhā honti, aññamaññaṃ nātivattantīti;
ps2.1:33.2: Uddhaccaṃ pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi sabbanimittehi animitto hoti nirodhagocaro, avijjaṃ pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā sabbanimittehi animittā hoti nirodhagocarā.
ps2.1:33.3: Iti animittaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganandhā honti, aññamaññaṃ nātivattantīti;
ps2.1:34.2: Uddhaccaṃ pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi sabbapaṇidīhi appaṇihito hoti nirodhagocaro, avijjaṃ pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā sabbapaṇidīhi appaṇihitā hoti nirodhagocarā.
ps2.1:34.3: Iti appaṇihitaṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganandhā honti, aññamaññaṃ nātivattantīti;
ps2.1:35.2: Uddhaccaṃ pajahato cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi sabbābhinevesehi suñño hoti nirodhagocaro, avijjaṃ pajahato anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā sabbābhinevesehi suññā hoti nirodhagocarā.
ps2.1:35.3: Iti suññataṭṭhena samathavipassanā ekarasā honti, yuganandhā honti, aññamaññaṃ nātivattantīti;
ps2.1:35.6: ‘Bhāvetīti'. Catasso bhāvanā: tattha jātānaṃ dhammānaṃ anativattanaṭṭhena bhāvanā, indriyānaṃ ekarasaṭṭhena bhāvanā, tadupagaviriyavāhanaṭṭhena bhāvanā,
ps2.1:35.8: maggo sañjāyatīti. Kathaṃ maggo sañjāyati? . . . pe . . .
ps2.1:35.12: Imehi soḷasahi ākārehi samathavipassanaṃ yuganandhaṃ bhāveti. Evaṃ samathavipassanaṃ yuganandhaṃ bhāveti.
ps2.1:36.2: Aniccato manasikaroto obhāso uppajjati. ‘Obhāso dhammo' ti obhāsaṃ āpajjati, tato vikkhepo uddhaccaṃ,
ps2.1:36.3: tena uddhaccena viggahitamānaso aniccato upaṭṭhānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, dukkhato upaṭṭhānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, anattato upaṭṭhānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti;
ps2.1:36.5: dhammuddhaccaviggahitamānaso hoti. So samayo, yan taṃ cittaṃ ajjhattañ ñeva santiṭṭhati sannisīdati ekodi hoti samādhiyati;
ps2.1:36.6: tassa maggo sañjāyatīti. Kathaṃ maggo sañjāyati? . . . pe . . .
ps2.1:36.7: Evaṃ maggo sañjāyati . . . pe . . . Evaṃ saññojanāni pahīyanti, anusayā byantihonti.
ps2.1:37.1: Aniccato manasikaroto ñāṇaṃ uppajjati, pīti uppajjati, passaddhi uppajjati, sukhaṃ uppajjati, adhimokkho uppajjati, paggaho uppajjati, upaṭṭhānaṃ uppajjati, upekkhā uppajjati, nikanti uppajjati. ‘Nikanti dhammo' ti nikantiṃ āpajjati,
ps2.1:37.3: tena uddhaccena viggahitamānaso aniccato upaṭṭhānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, dukkhato upaṭṭhānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, anattato upaṭṭhānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti;
ps2.1:37.5: dhammuddhaccaviggahitamānaso hoti. So samayo, yan taṃ cittaṃ ajjhattañ ñeva santiṭṭhati sannisīdati ekodi hoti samādhiyati;
ps2.1:37.8: Evaṃ maggo sañjāyati . . . pe . . . Evaṃ saññojanāni pahīyanti, anusayā byantihonti.
ps2.1:38.2: anattato manasikaroto obhāso uppajjati, ñāṇaṃ uppajjati, pīti uppajjati, passaddhi uppajjati, sukhaṃ uppajjati, adhimokkho uppajjati, paggaho uppajjati, upaṭṭhānaṃ uppajjati, upekkhā uppajjati, nikanti uppajjati. ‘Nikanti dhammo' ti nikantiṃ āpajjati,
ps2.1:38.4: tena uddhaccena viggāhitamānaso anattato upaṭṭhānaṃ aniccato upaṭṭhānaṃ dukkhato upaṭṭhānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti;
ps2.1:38.7: Evaṃ saññojanāni pahīyanti, anusayā byantihonti. Paṭis_II,I.10:
ps2.1:39.10: jarāmaraṇaṃ dukkhato manasikaroto, jarāmaraṇaṃ anattato manasikaroto obhāso uppajjati, ñāṇaṃ uppajjati . . . pe . . . nikanti uppajjati. ‘Nikanti dhammo' ti nikantiṃ āpajjati,
ps2.1:39.14: jarāmaraṇaṃ aniccato upaṭṭhānaṃ, jarāmaraṇaṃ dukkhato upaṭṭhānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti;

ps2.1:45.1: Imehi catūhi ṭhānehi cittasaṅkhepavikkhepaṃ avikkhepaṃ viggahitaṃ dasaṭṭhāṇehi pajānātīti. Yuganandhakathā. Paṭis_II,II.1:
